scope: Linux x64 native Lean versus full Wasm shell argument ordering. Original upstream tests remain unchanged. This is a targeted repair, not a complete-suite or cross-platform result.
diagnosis: Emscripten musl permutes positional operands immediately. Native glibc defers permutation, and Lean stops at --run. Consume operands in order, discard preceding operands at --run, and retain them at ordinary parse completion. Explicitly handle a lone dash and retain POSIXLY_CORRECT ordering.
